title: SDKs and community projects are easier to find
summary:
A tune-up for image prompt enhancement and text requests, with SDKs made easier to find.

The README and website showcase gained an SDKs & Libraries section covering React and Python integrations. AI-Bloom was also added to the project list, and Pollinations Gallery was marked as new.

Image prompt-enhancement requests now identify themselves to the text API and bypass its normal per-IP queue. Image safe mode also changed how it handles content flags.

JSON mode now accepts `json: true` as a boolean without a type error. Other text traffic is limited to one concurrent request per IP, with a longer delay after generation errors; Sur also moved to an OpenAI-backed variant.
